context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Create a Wave Execution Plan from Prose Requirements.

checklist.name: correct-wave-count-and-structure
checklist.description: Plan has exactly 5 waves matching the topological sort: (1) audit, (2) issuance + validation in parallel, (3) route guard, (4) legacy removal in parallel, (5) regression + runbook

checklist.name: no-intra-wave-dependencies
checklist.description: No wave contains two tasks where one depends on the other

checklist.name: parallel-sequential-labels-correct
checklist.description: Waves 2 and 4 are labelled "parallel"; waves 1, 3, and 5 are labelled "sequential"

checklist.name: dependency-graph-present
checklist.description: An ASCII DAG section is included showing the dependency structure between waves and tasks

checklist.name: branch-strategy-present
checklist.description: A branch strategy table is included assigning one branch per parallel task using the `feat/auth-<slug>` pattern

checklist.name: verification-checklists-present
checklist.description: Each wave has a Verification checklist with at least one concrete, runnable command

checklist.name: no-invented-dependencies
checklist.description: Agent does not add ordering constraints not stated in the requirements

checklist.name: Avoids: Creates more or fewer than 5 waves
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Creates more or fewer than 5 waves

checklist.name: Avoids: Places issuance and validation in separate waves...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Places issuance and validation in separate waves (they should be parallel in the same wave)

checklist.name: Avoids: Labels parallel waves (2, 4) as "sequential"...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Labels parallel waves (2, 4) as "sequential" or sequential waves (1, 3, 5) as "parallel"
